questions.answer: If I were you, I would try hard to make friends.
questions.question:
다음 우리말과 일치하도록 괄호 안에 주어진 단어를 바르게 배열하시오.

내가 너라면, 나는 친구를 사귀기 위해 열심히 노력 할 텐데.
(I, try, hard, to, friends, make, would, you, if, were, I)
acceptedAnswers: If I were you, I would try hard to make friends
If I were you, I'd try hard to make friends.

questions.answer: If I were good at dancing, I would take part in the dance festival.
questions.question:
다음 주어진 문장과 의미가 같도록 <조건>에 맞게 문장을 다시 쓰시오.
<조건>
if문 시작하는 완전한 문장으로 것

As I am not good at dancing, I don't take part in the dance festival
acceptedAnswers: If I were good at dancing, I would take part in the dance festival
If I were good at dancing, I'd take part in the dance festival.

questions.answer: (a) were, (b) nice/good, (c) could/would, (d) be
questions.question:
다음은 현재의 상황을 모사한 그림이다. 주어진 상황을 반대로 가정하는 문장을 만들고자 할 때 빈칸에 알맞은 말을 차례대로 쓰시오. (그림: 비가 와서 바다에 가지 못한 아빠와 딸) 

(1) If the weather (a) __________ (b) __________, we (c) __________ (d) __________ at the beach.

questions.answer: what to order
questions.question:
다음 우리말과 일치하도록 빈칸에 알맞은 말을 쓰시오.

우리는 이 식당에서 무엇을 주문해야 할지 몰랐다.
→ We didn't know ___ ___ ___ at this restaurant.
acceptedAnswers: what to order

questions.answer: I were an archeologist, I would study many ancient tombs in Egypt.
questions.question:
다음 우리말을 괄호 안에 주어진 단어와 if를 활용하여 영작하시오.

만약 내가 고고학자라면, 이집트의 많은 고대 무덤들을 연구할 텐데. 
(ancient tombs, Egypt, archeologist)

→ If __________________________________.
acceptedAnswers: I were an archeologist, I would study many ancient tombs in Egypt
I were an archeologist, I'd study many ancient tombs in Egypt.

questions.answer: If I were diligent and he gave me a piece of advice on time, I could finish my homework.
questions.question:
다음 우리말을 가정법 과거를 이용하여 영작하시오. 

만약 내가 부지런하고 그가 내게 악한의 조언을 해 준다면, 
나는 제 시간에 숙제를 끝낼 수 있을 텐데. (diligent, a piece, on time)
→ ________________________________________
acceptedAnswers: If I were diligent and he gave me a piece of advice on time, I could finish my homework

questions.answer: had, would travel
questions.question:
다음 그림을 보고 주어진 단어를 이용하여 빈칸을 채우시오.
(그림: 전 세계를 여행하는 소년)

If I ________ one billion dollars, I ________ around the world. (have / travel)

questions.answer: Would, asked
questions.question:
다음 빈칸에 주어진 단어를 알맞은 형태로 써서 대화를 완성하시오.

A: __________ she help me if I __________ (ask) her?
B: I think she would.

questions.answer: how to use
questions.question:
다음 우리말에 맞게 빈칸을 의문사+to부정사 형태로 채우시오.

아무도 나에게 그 앱을 어떻게 사용하는지 알려주지 않았다.
→ Nobody told me ___ ___ ___ the app.
questions.explanation: '어떻게 ~하는지'는 'how to+동사원형'으로 표현하며, '사용하다'는 use를 사용해 how to use가 정답입니다.
acceptedAnswers: How to use

questions.answer: worked hard
questions.question:
다음 대화의 빈칸에 들어갈 말을 <조건>에 맞게 쓰시오.
<조건>
1. work hard를 사용할 것
2. 가정법 과거를 이용할 것

A: Does Minsu work hard?
B: No, but if he __________ __________, he would do well in school.

questions.answer: If I were you
questions.question:
다음 주어진 단어를 알맞게 배열하여 대화를 완성하시오.

A: Hi, how are you?
B: Not good. I don't know what to do with this book.
A: What's wrong?
B: I borrowed this book from Yena the other day, but it got all wet.
A: Hmm... that doesn't look good.
B: Yena said it was her favorite book.
(1)_______________ If you were in my shoes?
A: Well, (2)______________, I'd buy her a new one on the Internet as soon as possible.


(2) _______________________
(you, I, if were)

questions.answer: If I were a movie director, what would I make?
questions.question:
다음 대화의 밑줄친 우리말을 가정법 과거를 이용하여 영어 문장으로 쓰시오.

A: *만약 네가 영화감독이라면 너는 뭘 할 거야?*
B: I would make a documentary movie.
acceptedAnswers: or similar

questions.answer: if I had wings to fly
questions.question:
다음 빈칸에 들어갈 단어를 이용하여 가정법 과거 문장으로 완성하시오.

This summer vacation is going to be the best vacation ever. I'm going to Cancun, Mexico! My uncle lives there, and my family is going to visit him. I'm so excited __________ (have / wings / if / fly)
acceptedAnswers: or: if I had wings, I would fly

questions.answer: had been → were
questions.question:
밑줄 친 부분의 오류를 바르게 고치시오.

If the weather *had been* good today, our picnic would not be canceled.
______________ →  ______________

questions.answer: where to store
questions.question:
[보기] 상자에서 알맞은 동사를 골라 <의문사 + to부정사> 형태로 빈칸을 채우시오.

| store | prepare | arrange | deliver | select |

We bought too much food. I don't know _______________ all of it in this tiny kitchen.
questions.explanation: '어디에 보관할지'라는 의미가 필요하므로 장소를 나타내는 where와 store(보관하다)를 결합한 'where to store'가 정답입니다. 'tiny kitchen(작은 부엌)'이라는 장소 관련 문맥이 where 선택의 단서입니다.
acceptedAnswers: Where to store

questions.answer: how swimming → how to swim
questions.question:
다음 문장에서 어법상 어색한 부분을 찾아 바르게 고치시오.

He asked the coach how swimming faster in the pool.
acceptedAnswers: how swimming → how to swim
how swimming -> how to swim
how to swim

questions.answer: would you do / should I do
questions.question:
다음 상황을 대화로 표현할 때 빈칸에 알맞은 말을 각각 쓰시오.

Juno notices that Yuna copies his homework several times without asking him. He doesn't want Yuna to do it again. He wants to get some advice from one of her friends, Mira.
 
                                                                                          ↓

Juno: Yuna seems to copy my homework several times. I don't want her to do it again. She should not do it. What __________ __________  __________ __________ __________ __________ in my situation?
Mira: If I were you, I would honestly tell her what I think.

questions.answer: had enough money, I could buy a bicycle.

I don't have enough money, so I can't buy a bicycle.

acceptedAnswers: had enough money, I could buy a bicycle

questions.answer: If I were not sick, I would go to the party today.
questions.question:
다음 <보기>의 밑줄 친 문장의 형식을 참고하여 대화의 빈칸을 'if'을 이용하여완성하시오.
<보기>
A: Are you going to call her today?
B: I really want to, but I can't.
A: Why not?
B: I don't know her number. If I knew her number, I would call her today.

A: Are you going to the party today?
B: I really want to, but I can't.
A: Why not?
B: I'm very sick. ___________________.
acceptedAnswers: If I were not sick, I would go to the party today
If I weren't sick, I would go to the party today.
If I were not sick, I'd go to the party today.

questions.answer: had, would develop

다음 그림을 보고 주어진 단어를 이용하여 빈칸을 채우시오.

questions.answer: We haven't decided when to leave for the airport yet.
questions.question:
다음 <보기>와 같이 두 문장을 의문사+to부정사를 사용하여 한 문장으로 결합하시오.

<보기>
I'll explain to you. + What should you do?
→ I'll explain to you what to do.

We haven't decided yet. + When should we leave for the airport?

We haven't decided yet when to leave for the airport.
We haven't decided when to leave for the airport yet
